brief:
The residence of a prominent Jewish anti-Zionist activist in Jerusalem's Mea Shearim neighborhood was set ablaze while his family remained inside, according to Voices of Rabbis, Middle East Eye reported. The incident marks an escalation in tensions within Jerusalem's Jewish communities.

No further details on injuries, arrests, or the circumstances surrounding the fire were immediately available. The organization did not specify a timeframe for when the fire occurred.
